nl_instruction: For each record in PA0000, join with one record in PA0001 where PA0001.BEGDA <= PA0000.BEGDA <= PA0001.ENDDA. For duplicate field names across table, rename them in the format TableName_FieldName format
sql:
SELECT 
    PA0000.MANDT,
    PA0000.PERNR,
    PA0000.BEGDA,
    PA0000.ENDDA,
    PA0000.SEQNR,
    PA0000.MASSN AS PA0000_MASSN,
    PA0000.MASSN_TEXT AS PA0000_MASSN_TEXT,
    PA0000.MASSG AS PA0000_MASSG,
    PA0000.MASSG_TEXT AS PA0000_MASSG_TEXT,
    PA0000.STAT2 AS PA0000_STAT2,
    PA0000.STAT2_TEXT AS PA0000_STAT2_TEXT,
    PA0001.BUKRS AS PA0001_BUKRS,
    PA0001.BUKRS_TEXT AS PA0001_BUKRS_TEXT,
    PA0001.WERKS AS PA0001_WERKS,
    PA0001.WERKS_TEXT AS PA0001_WERKS_TEXT,
    PA0001.BTRTL AS PA0001_BTRTL,
    PA0001.PERSG AS PA0001_PERSG,
    PA0001.PERSG_TEXT AS PA0001_PERSG_TEXT,
    PA0001.PERSK AS PA0001_PERSK,
    PA0001.PERSK_TEXT AS PA0001_PERSK_TEXT,
    PA0001.KOSTL AS PA0001_KOSTL,
    PA0001.ORGEH AS PA0001_ORGEH,
    PA0001.PLANS AS PA0001_PLANS,
    PA0001.ABKRS AS PA0001_ABKRS,
    PA0001.ABKRS_TEXT AS PA0001_ABKRS_TEXT
FROM 
    PA0000
INNER JOIN 
    PA0001
ON 
    PA0001.MANDT = PA0000.MANDT
    AND PA0001.PERNR = PA0000.PERNR
    AND PA0001.BEGDA <= PA0000.BEGDA
    AND PA0000.BEGDA <= PA0001.ENDDA;
